Class NativeBoardMemory

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.internal.NativeBoardMemory
All Implemented Interfaces:
BoardMemory
public final class NativeBoardMemory extends Object implements BoardMemory
The board's BoardMemory: each method is an intrinsic the compiler lowers to its runtime shim, so it has no Java body and cannot run, or be mocked, on a desktop JVM. Mock BoardMemory instead.
